message: ４人寄っても

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, ideas, please!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even if you spring it on me like that~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You were there when Misa came by, weren't you!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahh, now that you mention it~ I feel like something like that did happen~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Synn
message: 「In the first place, why am I at a Sweets Club meeting?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even a dead tree adds to the liveliness of the mountain~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's just say you're an advisor」

name: Paqy
message: 「And the brilliant yours truly comes along as part of the package, of course」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Besides, Nana-chan gets way more fired up when Synn-kun is around~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-Th-That's not true at all」

name: Yumil
message: 「If we're gonna participate in the Holy Night Festival, it's gotta be something that really hypes the festival up, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Speaking of hyping things up, how about a human cannonball~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who's supposed to do that」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm down to do it. My body's super sturdy」

name: Synn
message: 「Something like that... I can't allow. It seems way too dangerous」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Before that, we don't even have the tech for it, do we」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Speaking of hyping things up, how about a karaoke contest~」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm down to do it. My throat's super sturdy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, that's good! After all, all we need is a venue and the equipment!」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm gonna sing my heart out. I'll hog all the prizes for myself too」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see! Then we don't even have to prepare any prizes~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Exactly」

name: Paqy
message: 「You sure you're okay with that」

name: Synn
message: 「That won't fly at a school event. Besides, it has nothing to do with the Sweets Club」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What if we say the prizes are sweets? And then we eat all of 'em!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you're a genius~」

name: Yumil
message: 「That's pretty wicked, man」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, I don't think that'll count toward our club activity record」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, right. From here on out, anything not related to sweets is banned!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Speaking of getting hyped up, offal hot pot is the way to go~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen to what I just said!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Offal hot pot definitely gets everyone hyped, yeah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mystery hot pot could be good too~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Mystery hot pot gets everyone hyped too, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「They aren't listening」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Saying no to hot pot... You're so strict, Synn-kun~」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys are just totally off track」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't forget this is for the Holy Night Festival\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's fine. I just remembered~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Holy Night Festival, Holy Night Festival, Holy Night Festival... Hrmmm」

name: Yumil
message: 「How 'bout we form a punk band? I can play the drums, y'know」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'll do vocals and triangle~」

name: Paqy
message: 「What kind of combo is that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. I can't play anything」

name: Yumil
message: 「All it takes is practice, man!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, like I said earlier, I don't think that'll count toward our club activity record」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Boo-hoo. Nana-chan and Synn-kun just keep shooting down ideas without offering any of your own」

name: Synn
message: 「A research presentation... maybe?」

name: Yumil
message: 「In that case, how about this? We present 'The Development of Viennese Pastries and the House of Habsburg' that Yuugiri-senpai wrote before」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That sounds pretty amazing! You wrote that, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well...」

name: Paqy
message: 「The title's the only impressive part about it」

name: Yumil
message: 「That's not true. It's a monumental work spanning 50 pages of report paper. Reading it is super moving」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That won't get anyone hyped up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, true. A research presentation is a bit...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Soba fortune-telling」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You tell tomorrow's fortune by the movement of soba noodle scraps dropped into water」

name: Synn
message: 「What the heck is that?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh, fortune-telling always gets people hyped up」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm totally down to be in charge of dropping the soba into the water」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please... shoot this one down too, you guys...」
